sentences.text: Heard Sri Sunil Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri S.B. Maurya, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Narendra Kumar with the prayer to quash the order dated 19.12.2022 in S.T. No. 1503 of 2021 (State of U.P. vs.
Nitin), arises from Case Crime No. 87 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station Purkaji, District Muzaffarnagar, pending before the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge (F.T.C. 1), Muzaffarnagar, and again remand the matter before the trial court to take fresh decision in this case in accordance with law and on the basis of statements taken by the Investigating Officer and statement of P.W.-1 before the trial court against the opposite party nos. 2 Narendra Kumar vs State Of U.P.
